title: NO SEA, NO OIL / STILL RICH?!

scenes.caption: SWITZERLAND
scenes.narration: This country has no sea, no oil and a lot of mountains.

scenes.title: INCOME PER PERSON
scenes.narration: Yet the average Swiss person earns more than twice as much as the average French person.

scenes.title: HOW?
scenes.narration: It stayed stable and neutral, trained skilled workers, and sold products the world pays extra for.
